description: Converts a note voltage into the control voltage that sets the root note on various quantizer modules

inputs.text: The note taken as the root; only its pitch class is read, so the octave makes no difference

outputs.text: A voltage from 1V to 10.167V in twelve steps of 0.834V, which selects the root note on Bidoo's Dikt@t
A voltage from 0.84V to 10.01V in twelve steps of 0.834V, which selects the root note on quantizers with a twelve-step root control

notes: The maker's README names the quantizers the twelve output was tested against: JW-Modules Quantizer, NoteSeq and NoteSeq16, docB JTScaler, Alef's Bits Slips and SS-Modules Melodygen.
Autinn's Fluencerator needs 5.83V subtracted from the twelve output before it will track, which the maker's README gives and the module does not do for you.
Some quantizers take a note voltage as their root directly and need nothing from this module; the maker's README names Orange Line Mother and Grande Quant.

inputs.0:
bipolar · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
